verdict.rationale: The plugin catalog and plugin sources are published in public GitHub repos (openai/plugins, openai/skills). A probe fetched the marketplace manifest keylessly and installed a skill as a plain portable folder, so the source is readable. However, no evidence names the license these repos are released under, so the 'open license' half of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: any stated open-source license (e.g., a LICENSE file or SPDX identifier), and evidence that the full plugin runtime source, not just catalog and skill content, is published.
